mapper.sql: NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM c2k_candidate_source cs LEFT JOIN c2k_source s ON s.tenant_id = cs.tenant_id AND s.id = cs.source_id WHERE cs.candidate_id = c.id AND (s.id IS NULL OR NOT s.enabled OR s.revision != cs.source_revision OR NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM c2k_source_grant g WHERE g.tenant_id = cs.tenant_id AND g.source_id = cs.source_id AND g.member_id = #{owner} AND g.source_revision = cs.source_revision ) OR EXISTS ())) )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM c2k_candidate c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND c.owner_id = #{owner} AND c.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM c2k_candidate c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND c.owner_id = #{owner} AND c.request_id = #{request}
SELECT c.* FROM c2k_candidate c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND c.owner_id = #{owner} AND ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id LIMIT 20 OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM c2k_candidate c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND c.owner_id = #{owner} AND
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO c2k_candidate (id, tenant_id, owner_id, device_id, request_id, digest, archive_sha256, archive_bytes, report, mode, task_id, attempt_id) VALUES (#{value.id}, #{value.tenantId}, #{value.ownerId}, #{value.deviceId}, #{value.requestId}, #{value.digest}, #{value.archiveSha256}, #{value.archiveBytes}, #{value.report}, #{value.mode}, #{value.taskId}, #{value.attemptId})

INSERT INTO c2k_candidate_source (candidate_id, tenant_id, source_id, source_revision, repository, commit_id, kind, path) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenant}, #{source.sourceId}, #{source.revision}, #{source.repository}, #{source.commit}, #{source.kind}, #{source.path})
